title: 🏆🎯 Accelerate your BC Go-Live with Gamification
summary: A gamification system for Dynamics 365 Business Central accelerates user adoption during go-live by letting teams compete in mastering key processes like sales and customer creation. The solution uses three tables and multiple pages to track achievements, points, and leaderboards across user roles.
key_points: Gamification targets resistance to change and low motivation during ERP go-lives by adding healthy competition between teams
Three tables (Achievement Definition, User Achievement Profile, User Achievement Log) plus a role center with separate user and administrator views
Event subscribers in the Achievement Events codeunit award points when users create customers, items, vendors, contacts or quotes, or post sales and purchase documents
Users climb point-based levels from Novice (0-499) up to Ultimate (5,000+) and follow their progress on their profile and the dashboard
The leaderboard ranks all users by total points with departmental metrics and is presented as the core of the solution
features: achievement event triggers (customer create, sales post, vendor create, item create, quote create, purchase post)
achievement difficulty levels and point system

quotes.text: Experience has taught us that Go-Live start-ups of any ERP usually face a common challenge: resistance to change.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core problem that gamification solves: adoption friction during go-live

quotes.text: The leaderboard where we see the progress of all users in different areas, demonstrating the skills gained as well as the points and badges.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the central motivational feature that makes competition transparent and reinforces achievement
